forward_price_basis.description: The 2020 demand-weighted difference between the published Ofgem forward index and the PyPSA clearing price is added to the CP30 delivery-period clearing price.

procurement_uplifts_and_losses.description: Seasonal and hourly shaping, re-hedging/forecast error, transaction, basis/risk and loss allowances retain their 2020 intensity relative to the forward-price proxy.

balancing.description: The central case scales the published 2020 supplier imbalance allowance with gross PyPSA redispatch as a share of demand. The cost-indexed case is diagnostic only: model bid/offer costs are not total NESO balancing expenditure.

non_wholesale.description: Network, policy, Capacity Market, adjustment, supplier operating, smart-metering, payment, margin and headroom allowances are held at their 2020 nominal benchmark values.

recovery_demand.description: A full-year consumer bill must convert PyPSA system demand into component-specific billable supplier sales, customer accounts and domestic recovery shares. The H1 sensitivity does not yet make this conversion.

component_registry.description: Use the forecast component registry to prevent treating system-transition, policy or retail changes as direct PyPSA pass-throughs.

scope_warning: This is a January-June 2030 CP30 scenario sensitivity. It is not a full-year 2030 Default Tariff Cap forecast.
